title: (To be deprecated) Run a Legacy Smart+ Campaign report
content_data:
Use this endpoint to run a report on Smart+ Campaigns and Smart Performance Web Campaigns at the creative level (video, ad text, Spark Ad post, catalog video, or catalog carousel). > **Important**
> - **Upgraded Smart+ API**: > - We are actively upgrading the Smart+ API to deliver enhanced capabilities and performance. The new Upgraded Smart+ API is already launched. Learn more about [Upgraded Smart+ Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1853452461203458) and [available Upgraded Smart+ API endpoints](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843301794874370). > - **Get started**: > - **Reporting**: No additional allowlist required. > - **Campaign Management**: To access the upgraded Smart+ experience, contact your TikTok sales representative to have your ad account allowlisted. If your ad account is already in the allowlist, you can directly use the Upgraded Smart+ API creation and modification endpoints. > - **Legacy API Deprecation**: > - After **March 31, 2026**, you will no longer be able to create legacy Smart+ Campaigns using the [/campaign/spc/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1767334204047362) endpoint. > - Note that legacy Smart+ Campaigns that have not been migrated will not be transitioned to the new API automatically. Attempts to use the legacy Smart+ API endpoint afterward will result in errors, rendering new campaign creation via this endpoint unavailable. > - **Legacy API deprecation extension request process for existing legacy Smart+ creation developers**: > - 1. **Submit a request**: If you require an extension, please submit an application via the [External Extension Request Form for Legacy Smart+ Creation API](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/share/base/form/shrlgsm2yMsQaSoAsMy77tcAzng). > - 2. **Allowlist processing**: After receiving your request, we will process an allowlist entry for the associated developer app ID. After the process, developers will be able to continue calling the `/campaign/spc/create/` endpoint until **June 30, 2026**. > - 3. **Extended timeline for strong business needs**: If you have a strong business case requiring an extension beyond June 30, 2026, please specify your use case in the application form, or contact your sales representative directly. > **Note**
>
  • The data returned via this endpoint might have a latency of 30 minutes.
  • Smart Performance Web Campaigns will be deprecated in the next API version. To ensure a smooth API integration, we recommend that you upgrade to [Smart+ Web Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1814122471133186) as soon as possible. Smart+ Web Campaigns are a new AI-powered automation solution that leverages machine learning to drive business outcomes for advertisers.
## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/report/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | campaign_ids {Required} | string[] |List of campaign IDs.

Max size: 1. | | material_type {Required} | string | Creative material type.

Enum values: `SPC_VIDEO`, `SPC_AD_TEXT`, `SPC_SPARK`, `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO`, `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.
  • If `material_type` is `SPC_VIDEO`, you can retrieve data on videos. You can specify basic data, video play, interaction, in-app event, in-app event (SKAN), page event, date, and video material details metric in the `metrics` field.
  • If `material_type` is `SPC_AD_TEXT`, you can retrieve data on ad texts. You can only specify basic data, interaction, in-app event, in-app event (SKAN), page event, and date metrics in the `metrics` field.
  • If `material_type` is `SPC_SPARK`, you can retrieve data on Spark Ad posts. You can only specify basic data, interaction, in-app event, in-app event (SKAN), and page event metrics in the `metrics` field.
  • If `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO`, you can retrieve data on catalog videos. You can only specify basic data, interaction, in-app event, in-app event (SKAN), page event and date metrics in the `metrics` field.
  • If `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`, you can retrieve data on catalog carousel. You can only specify basic data, interaction, in-app event, in-app event (SKAN), page event and date metrics in the `metrics` field.

To learn about the specific metrics within each metric type, see [Metrics in Smart+ Campaign reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1776461365424129).

Note:

  • When`material_type` is set to `SPC_SPARK`, ensure the `campaign_ids` field only includes a campaign that contains Spark Ads exclusively. If any campaign specified within `campaign_ids` contains both Spark Ads and non-Spark Ads, an empty list will be returned.
  • Smart+ Campaign reports of the `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO` or `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL` type are only supported for [Smart+ Catalog Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1814122471133186#item-link-Create%20Smart+%20Catalog%20Ads).
| | is_include_removed_material | boolean | Valid only when `material_type` is `SPC_VIDEO`, `SPC_AD_TEXT`, or `SPC_SPARK`.

Whether to query data of deleted videos, texts, or posts.

Supported values:
  • `true`: Include data of deleted videos, texts, or posts in the response.
  • `false` : Not include data of deleted videos, texts, or posts in the response.
Default value: `true`. | | metrics | string[] |Metrics to query.

Default value: `["spend", "impressions"]` .

Refer to [Metrics in Smart+ Campaign reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1776461365424129) for all supported metrics for a report. | | query_lifetime | boolean | Whether to request the lifetime metrics.

Default value: `false`.

If `query_lifetime` = `true`, the `start_date` and `end_date` parameters will be ignored. | | start_date {+Conditional} | string | Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or not specified.

Query start date (closed interval) in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD`.

The date is based on the ad account time zone. | | end_date {+Conditional} | string | Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or not specified.

Query end date (closed interval) in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD`.

The date is based on the ad account time zone.

Note: The time difference between `start_date` and `end_date` must be less than 365 days. | | page | number | Current page number.

Default value: 1. | | page_size | number | Page size.

Value range: 1-100.
Default value: 10. | ``` ### Example #### Run a report on videos ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location -request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/report/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&material_type=SPC_VIDEO&campaign_ids=[["{{campaign_id}}"]]&query_lifetime=true&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### Run a report on ad texts ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location -request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/report/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&material_type=SPC_AD_TEXT&campaign_ids=[["{{campaign_id}}"]]&query_lifetime=true&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### Run a report on Spark Ad posts ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location -request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/report/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&material_type=SPC_SPARK&campaign_ids=["{{campaign_id}}"]&query_lifetime=true&is_include_removed_material=true&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### Run a report on catalog videos ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location -request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/report/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&material_type=SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO&campaign_ids=["{{campaign_id}}"]&query_lifetime=true&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### Run a report on catalog carousel ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location -request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/report/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&material_type=SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL&campaign_ids=["{{campaign_id}}"]&query_lifetime=true&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable | Field | Data Type | Description | |-----|-------|-----| | code | number | Response code.
For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | message | string | Response message.
For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | request_id | string | The unique ID of the request. | |data | object | Returned data. | #| list | object[] | Data list. | ##| dimensions| object | Dimension data. | ###| material_id| string | Material ID. | ###| campaign_id | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_VIDEO`, `SPC_AD_TEXT`, or `SPC_SPARK`.

Campaign ID. | ###| catalog_id | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO` or `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.

Catalog ID. | ##|metrics | object | Metric data.

The following metrics will be returned alongside the metrics you specify via `metrics` in the request based on `material_type`:

  • When `material_type` is `SPC_VIDEO`: `is_removed_from_spc`, `video_id` and `file_name`.
  • When `material_type` is `SPC_AD_TEXT`: `is_removed_from_spc`, and `ad_text`.
  • When `material_type` is `SPC_SPARK`:`is_removed_from_spc`, `tiktok_item_id`, `identity_id` and `tiktok_name`.
  • When `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO` or `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`: `catalog_name`, `catalog_create_time`, and `catalog_modify_time`.
| ###|{metric_name} | string | Returned metrics, which are determined by the `metrics` field specified in your request.

Note: If your metrics include `video_resolution`, its data type is object. | ###| is_removed_from_spc | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_VIDEO`, `SPC_AD_TEXT`, or `SPC_SPARK`.

Whether the material is removed from the Smart+ ads.

Enum values:
  • `"1"`: true.
  • `"0"`: false.
| ###|video_id | string |Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_VIDEO`.

Video ID.| ###|file_name | string |Returned only when `material_type` is`SPC_VIDEO`.

Video name. | ###|ad_text | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_AD_TEXT`.

Ad text. | ###| identity_id | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_SPARK`.

Identity ID. | ###| tiktok_item_id | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_SPARK`.

The ID of the TikTok post to be used as an ad (Spark Ad). | ###| tiktok_name | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_SPARK`.

The username of the TikTok account.

Note: Currently, Smart+ Campaigns support TikTok posts with `identity_type` as `AUTH_CODE` or `TT_USER`. For details about identities, see [Identities](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738958351620097). | ###| catalog_name| string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO` or `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.

The name of the catalog. | ###| catalog_create_time | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO` or `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.

The time when the catalog was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`(UTC+0).

Example: `2024-00-01 00:00:00`. | ###| catalog_modify_time | string | Returned only when `material_type` is `SPC_CATALOG_VIDEO` or `SPC_CATALOG_CAROUSEL`.

The time when the catalog was last modified, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`(UTC+0).

Example: `2024-00-01 00:00:00`. | #| page_info | object | Pagination information. | ##| page | number | Current page number. | ##| page_size | number | Page size. | ##| total_number | number| Total number of results. | ##| total_page | number | Total pages of results. | ``` ### Example #### Run a report on videos ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "metrics": { "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "is_removed_from_spc": "0", "file_name": "{{file_name}}", "impressions": "0", "spend": "0.0" }, "dimensions": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } } ], "page_info": { "page_size": 100, "total_page": 1, "page": 1, "total_number": 1 } } } (/code) ``` #### Run a report on ad texts ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "metrics": { "ad_text": "{{ad_text}}", "is_removed_from_spc": "0", "spend": "0.0", "impressions": "0" }, "dimensions": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } }, { "metrics": { "ad_text": "{{ad_text}}", "is_removed_from_spc": "0", "spend": "0.0", "impressions": "0" }, "dimensions": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "total_page": 1, "page_size": 100, "total_number": 2 } } } (/code) ``` #### Run a report on Spark Ad posts ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "page_info": { "page": 1, "total_page": 1, "total_number": 4, "page_size": 100 }, "list": [ { "metrics": { "spend": "0.0", "is_removed_from_spc": "0", "identity_id": "{{identity_id}}", "tiktok_name": "{{tiktok_name}}", "tiktok_item_id": "{{tiktok_item_id}}", "impressions": "0" }, "dimensions": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } }, ..., { "metrics": { "spend": "0.0", "is_removed_from_spc": "0", "identity_id": "{{identity_id}}", "tiktok_name": "{{tiktok_name}}", "tiktok_item_id": "{{tiktok_item_id}}", "impressions": "0" }, "dimensions": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "material_id": "{{material_id}}" } } ] } } (/code) ``` #### Run a report on catalog videos ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "page_info": { "page_size": 100, "total_number": 1, "page": 1, "total_page": 1 }, "list": [ { "dimensions": { "catalog_id": "{{catalog_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}" }, "metrics": { "catalog_name": "{{catalog_name}}", "catalog_create_time": "{{catalog_create_time}}", "impressions": "0", "spend": "0.000", "catalog_modify_time": "{{catalog_modify_time}}" } } ] } } (/code) ``` #### Run a report on catalog carousel ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "dimensions": { "catalog_id": "{{catalog_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}" }, "metrics": { "spend": "0.000", "impressions": "0", "catalog_modify_time": "{{catalog_modify_time}}", "catalog_create_time": "{{catalog_create_time}}", "catalog_name": "{{catalog_name}}" } } ], "page_info": { "total_number": 1, "total_page": 1, "page_size": 100, "page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
